name: Trykr
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Trykr is a Danish online print shop. Make a business card, flyer, postcard, poster, sticker or sign with ChatGPT, and Trykr turns the image into a print-ready file in the exact size of the product – with bleed, a cut line and an automatic file check.

You see a preview with the cut line and the safe zone right in the chat, prices incl. Danish VAT and delivery, and a link to trykr.dk, where you choose quantity and delivery and order. Trykr tells you what can't be made from an image (foil, spot UV, folds), warns when an image has too few pixels for the size, and can print in your own size when a design doesn't fit a standard format.

Delivery in Denmark. Prices in DKK.
